name: atlas-reweave
display_name: Atlas Reweave: Albert Tan Sin Hon
description: Durable local computation receipts with versioned acceptance for trusted agent callbacks.
long_description: Four local stdio tools over an operator-selected SQLite store. Two tools read metadata; two can generate fixture work or write acceptance judgements. The supplied stages are deterministic software examples. No model account, API key, hosted service or network tool is provided. The bundle packages source version 0.1.0a1 and locked MCP 2.3.0 dependencies through UV. Desktop client interfaces have not been independently tested.

store_directory.title: Local work directory
store_directory.description: Choose an existing trusted local directory for reweave.sqlite3 and its ownership sidecar. Each running server needs its own store.

scope.title: Work scope
scope.description: A fixed label separating this server's work identities. Keep it unchanged when reopening the same work.

tools.name: list_stages
tools.description: Read the registered fixture stages and their revisions.

tools.name: run_registered_stage
tools.description: Run a trusted registered stage and persist its receipt or judgement.

tools.name: recheck_work
tools.description: Revalidate stored work and parents; may write a judgement.

tools.name: inspect_receipt
tools.description: Read historical receipt metadata without claiming current acceptance.
